description: Honeywell International Inc. is an integrated operating company serving a broad range of industries and geographies around the world, with a portfolio underpinned by its Honeywell Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Forge platform, and a portfolio of solutions uniquely positioned to blend physical products with software to serve customers worldwide. On February 6, 2025 it announced plans to separate Honeywell from Honeywell Aerospace into two independent U.S. public companies, with its Honeywell business to be a leading global, pure-play automation company delivering productivity-enhancing mission-critical solutions, and its Honeywell Aerospace business to be a leading global tier-1 aerospace and defense supplier of mission-critical systems and technologies that enable the production, maintenance and safe operation of aerospace and defense platforms, providing actionable solutions and innovations for aerospace, building automation, industrial automation, process automation and process technology. The Honeywell brand dates back to 1906 and the company was incorporated in Delaware in 1985.
